answer: Each session key rotates only after a piece of work is accepted, and the payment sits in escrow until the block reaches finality, so a bot that mints keys without shipping anything holds an anchor with no chain. Duplicates are caught by replaying the payload, not by reading the name. Add it up: one key cycle per accepted task, a hundred epochs of vesting, and a bond per identity. At that price a thousand-agent farm burns real money before it reaches the ledge, which is the beacon I would watch.
